scores.visual_critic_note: Clean card layout and opacity-depth encoding show intentionality, but the edge bundle convergence creates a murky dark mass at center, Tableau10 is still a library default palette, and the control row is functionally crowded rather than designed.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest: scaleSqrt used correctly for force-layout node sizing, d3.pack handles circle area natively, all scale domains are data-driven (d3.extent/root.height), key functions present on data joins, and sunburst correctly applies sqrt radial scaling — no truncated baselines, lie factor, or dual-axis issues, with minor caveat that hardcoded width/height constants are fixed layout bounds rather than magic quantitative domains.
scores.stress_test_note: Easing param sliders and the animation toggle fire `updateLayout()` (a full 1500ms transition) on every `input` event without debouncing or a preceding `.interrupt()`, causing cascading mid-flight transitions that stomp each other; the tension slider similarly calls `redrawLinks()` on every mousemove with no RAF coalescing.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Color groupings and nested circle hierarchy read clearly, but 300 edges routed through a shared center at 8% tension collapse into an unreadable tangle — the interaction-dependent highlight/fade that would rescue this cannot be assessed from a static screenshot.
